meta.analysis: D04 frozen-model local weather-lag sensitivity atlas
meta.unit: fraction change per common D03 transformed-weather SD, uniformly shifted over one lag band
meta.interpretation: local model sensitivity on observed paths; not a feasible weather intervention or causal impact
meta.summary_weights: means/RMS use original design weights conditional on each slice; all is pooled, not regime-balanced
meta.spread_weights: county-mean quantiles weight counties equally; event extrema are unweighted ranges, not intervals
meta.reference_scale_scope: D03 full-D outcome-value-blind scale used only to express report units, never for fitting
